---
title: "TAOOH Model Fitting"
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| output: false
library(fs)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(rmsb)
library(markov.misc)
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_path <- here("0-main-analysis", "TAOOH", "imp-data")
m <- length(dir_ls(data_path))
```

## Create output directory

```{r}
output_dir <- here("0-main-analysis", "TAOOH", "results")
dir_create(output_dir)
dir_create(path(output_dir, "models"))
dir_create(path(output_dir, "sops"))
dir_create(path(output_dir, "diagnostics"))
```

## Fit models and calculate estimand

```{r}
for(i in 1:m) {
  posterior_file <- path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("posterior_imp_", i, ".png"))
  model_file <- path(output_dir, "models", paste0("model_imp_", i, ".rds"))

  if (file_exists(posterior_file)) {
    cat("Skipping imputation", i, "- posterior already saved:", posterior_file, "\n")
    next
  }

  cat("Processing imputation", i, "of", m, "\n")

  # If model exists, load it and regenerate diagnostics only
  if (file_exists(model_file)) {
    cat("Found existing model for imputation", i, "- regenerating diagnostics\n")
    model <- readRDS(model_file)

    # ensure environment/options expected by diagnostic functions
    stanDx(model)

    trace_plot <- stanDxplot(model)
    ggsave(path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("trace_imp_", i, ".png")),
      plot = trace_plot,
      width = 20, height = 16, dpi = 300)

    dens_plot <- plot(model)
    ggsave(posterior_file,
      plot = dens_plot,
      width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

    next
  }


  data <- read_parquet(here("0-main-analysis", "TAOOH", "imp-data", paste0("taooh-data-", i, ".parquet"))) |>
    mutate(
      ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, ordered = FALSE),
      tx = as.numeric(as.character(tx)))


  dd <- datadist(data)
  options(datadist = 'dd')
  options(mc.cores = 4)

  pcontrast_po <- list(
    c1 = list(tx = 1),
    c2 = list(tx = 0),
    contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
    mu = 0,
    sd = 0.541
  )

  # Prior on the non-proportional effect (threshold 4 only, for transition to state 5)
  # Using a narrower prior here
  # pcontrast_npo <- list(
  #   c1 = list(tx = 1),
  #   c2 = list(tx = 0),
  #   contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  #   mu = 0,
  #   sd = 0.3  # Narrower prior for the non-proportional effect
  # )

  options(mc.cores = 4)
  Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO = 1)
  model <-
      blrm(
          formula = y ~ tx + rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev + week %ia% yprev + week %ia% ypprev + ecog_fstcnt + diagnosis + rcs(albumin, 3) + rcs(c_reactive_protein, 3) + cluster(id),
          data = data,
          # ppo = ~tx,
          # cppo = function(y) y,
          # cppo = function(y) y == 5, # to relax PO for treatment
          pcontrast = pcontrast_po,    # Prior for PO effect
          # cpcontrast = pcontrast_npo,  # Prior for non-PO effect (threshold 4)
          refresh = 5,
          iter = 2000,
          chains = 4,
          seed = 68818,
          loo = FALSE,
          method = "sampling",
          backend = "cmdstan",
          # sampling.args = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
          )
  Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO = 0)

  stanDx(model)

  # Save model object
  saveRDS(model, file = path(output_dir, "models", paste0("model_imp_", i, ".rds")))

  # Generate diagnostic plots
  trace_plot <- stanDxplot(model)
  ggsave(path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("trace_imp_", i, ".png")),
    plot = trace_plot,
    width = 20, height = 16, dpi = 300)

  dens_plot <- plot(model)
  ggsave(path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("posterior_imp_", i, ".png")),
    plot = dens_plot,
    width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
```
